number_unit_provenance.solve_em_binding: solve_em.F:4000 passes scalar(...,P_QNC) directly as QNC_CURR
number_unit_provenance.driver_binding: module_microphysics_driver.F:2813 passes qnc_curr directly as NC to udm; no density multiplication

number_unit_provenance.helper_convention: adjust_number_concent compares nn to ncmin=1e-3 commented m-3 (module_mp_udm.F:74) and its fallback/clamp formula uses den*qq and piconst=pi*denr/6, yielding a volume-concentration numeric convention. interpretation_limit: Local branch amplification only; does not identify upstream MPI divergence or establish full UDM/forecast cause. Equivalent radius is computed diagnostically from returned q,n using the production mass-number relation; it is not returned by adjust_number_concent.
